decisions.reason: The green level-4 bullet changes visual appearance, not Tab-driven level transitions, hierarchy structure, or nested alignment.
The source specifies a green bullet for bullet-list level 4 and does not alter numbered-list alignment or multi-digit numbering behavior.
Adding the level-4 green bullet does not change the required style prefix, naming language, or covered naming categories.
The source message separately specifies caption typography, which is already represented by a same-message MODIFY; the green-bullet change adds no further typography impact.
The source separately reports missing theme colors, already represented in this Requirement's history; specifying a green level-4 bullet does not change the theme-color requirement state.
Bullet appearance is independent of keeping pasted right-hand columns within page margins.
The level-4 green-bullet specification does not modify the required stability or predictability of legacy-content migration.
The bullet visual change does not affect manual line-break entry after pasted content.
The broad obligation to apply the specified style system consistently remains unchanged; the new visual detail is owned by the atomic bullet-formatting Requirement and should not be duplicated here.
The level-4 bullet appearance does not change table stability or right-column boundary behavior during paste.
The source adds a bullet-style detail without changing the supported Word environment or general operational-reliability constraint.
